items.summary: Recommendation: reject the three queued site-factory change requests and any new spend, implementation, telemetry, or CRO work this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with 57 improvements measuring, 21 failed requests, and 108 approved proposals lacking execution. Financial evidence does not support expansion: Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21 and reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, all in aggregate tracking_id=other and therefore not assignable to any site. AI usage is $1,002.46 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 across 5,531 calls; the periods and attribution keys do not align, so contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, and revenue forecasts are not calculable. Preserve only the canonical allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement after CTO releases one slot by 2026-10-01T09:00Z. Do not describe its 61 registered clicks, 0 ordered items, or $0 site-attributed commission as revenue traction; measure clicks and available conversions only. SearchWoot remains private and rights outreach unsent.

Retain request 4719e525-763b-42a4-9f16-e71e1c38b17b only after one delivery slot is released. Its financial acceptance boundary is registered affiliate-click and available site-conversion measurement for 14 days or 100 relevant impressions/clicks. Preserve the 2026-09-21 baseline of 61 clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission. Do not claim revenue, margin, ROI, causal lift, or payback. Do not add tracking, credentials, spend, dependencies, or configuration changes.

Keep the Amazon aggregate row visible but unassigned. The only revenue evidence is $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21 under tracking_id=other; it cannot be allocated across sites without inventing attribution. Minimum measurement for site contribution margin is a common period plus site-level revenue/commission keyed to registered tracking IDs, direct AI and infrastructure costs, and any other variable operating costs. Until those fields exist, report revenue as unknown at site level and do not forecast from clicks, ordered items, shipped items, sessions, impressions, or conversions.

No monthly spend limit, fixed-cost baseline, revenue target, revenue floor, or marketing budget is populated in the brief. Therefore budget exposure and total fleet contribution margin are not calculable. AI spend is known at $1,002.45979265 for September 2026, but infrastructure, domain, hosting, labor, and other direct costs are absent; cost-to-learn is also not calculable because no experiment-level cost and attributable outcome denominator exists. Minimum finance artifact is a report-only reconciliation using existing records: period-aligned revenue, registered site/content identifiers, AI cost, infrastructure/domain cost, experiment or implementation cost, and measured incremental outcome. This requires no new telemetry, spend, billing access, banking access, contracts, or production changes.
